title: Steven Greer cut the four-fingered arm from the 2000 Weygandt interview

tellings.quote: >> this was actually one of the things that Steven Greer cut out of their year 2000 interview.

plain: In a 2000 interview a witness named Jonathan Weygandt described a four-fingered arm, and Steven Greer, a campaigner for UFO disclosure, cut that part out of the footage, according to a researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb. He points to the raw files of the interview in Greer's archive, and names the filmmaker James Fox as part of the story. If true, it would mean an alien body detail was left out of what the public saw.
